record.name: higgsfield
record.one_liner: AI-native creative suite providing image, video, and audio generation models accessible via REST API, CLI, and MCP servers.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up, top up a prepaid balance in US dollars, and create API keys directly.
record.api_note: Covers over 50 video and image generation models with asynchronous request lifecycles, webhooks, and SDKs.
